topic: Which Times Square would you explore?
core_subject: Times Square Manhattan crossroads and iconic billboard canyon

files.name: 01.png
files.label: AFTER THE FALL
files.must_show: Times Square Manhattan crossroads with a large central stack of blank billboard screens and an empty weed-filled pedestrian crossing.
files.observed_subject: A recognizable Times Square central billboard tower above a deserted cracked crosswalk, blank screens, weeds and morning sun.

files.name: 02.png
files.label: WINTER NEON
files.must_show: Times Square Manhattan crossroads with bright stacked billboard screens, snow-covered sidewalk and a busy pedestrian crossing.
files.observed_subject: The central stacked billboard tower and Times Square street canyon with snow, taxis, pedestrians and brightly illuminated screens.

files.name: 03.png
files.label: JUNGLE RECLAIMED
files.must_show: Times Square Manhattan crossroads with stacked billboard screens, an overgrown pedestrian crossing and vegetation-covered buildings.
files.observed_subject: Times Square stacked central billboard tower, overgrown buildings, red steps, vegetation in crosswalk and abandoned yellow taxi.

files.name: 04.png
files.label: RAINY CYBERPUNK
files.must_show: Times Square Manhattan crossroads with towering illuminated billboard facades, taxis and wet pedestrian crossing.
files.observed_subject: Recognizable Times Square stacked billboard tower, dense colorful illuminated screens, yellow taxis and wet pedestrian crossing at night.

files.name: 05.png
files.label: SNOWFALL CITY LIGHTS
files.must_show: Times Square Manhattan crossroads with stacked glowing billboard screens, snow flurries and a wet pedestrian crossing.
files.observed_subject: The Times Square billboard canyon and central stacked screen tower amid snow flurries, taxis and illuminated wet streets.
